examples.question: My plan offers three benefit package options a PPO, a POS arrangement, and an HMO. If the HMO relinquishes grandfather status, does that mean that the PPO and POS arrangement must also relinquish grandfather status?
examples.answer_start: No. The grandfather analysis applies on a benefit-package-by-benefit-package basis. In this situation, it is permissible to treat the PPO, POS arrangement, and HMO as separate benefit packages. Accordingly, if any benefit package ceases grandfather status, it does not affect the grandfather status of the other benefit packages.
